content: {"summary":"In November 2025 the orders‑db ran out of usable connection slots, causing PostgreSQL 53300 errors that surfaced as ORD‑5003 in orders‑api. The exhaustion was caused by a commerce‑namespace batch job that leaked ~222 idle sessions, filling the 297 usable slots (75 reserved for orders‑api itself). The RB‑012 runbook prescribes the standard mitigation steps: reduce client pool sizes, terminate idle sessions, or raise max_connections, and provides queries to identify the offending sessions.","likely_cause":"Idle‑session leak from a batch job that left ~222 connections open, exhausting the orders‑db connection pool.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"orders‑db ran out of connection slots on 22 Nov 2025, triggering 53300 errors and ORD‑5003","evidence_ids":["INC-0103#0"],"quote":"orders-db-01 out of connection slots, 22 November 2025"},{"text":"A batch job opened a new connection per batch and never closed them, leaving about 222 idle sessions","evidence_ids":["INC-0103#1"],"quote":"The Job had opened a new connection for every batch it processed and had never closed one"},{"text":"orders‑api can use at most 75 connections (3 pods × pool max 25) so the remaining slots were taken by other sessions","evidence_ids":["RB-012#3"],"quote":"orders-db | orders-api, `pg` Pool `max` 25, 3 pods"},{"text":"The runbook RB‑012 recommends first reducing client pool sizes, then terminating idle sessions, then raising max_connections","evidence_ids":["RB-012#6"],"quote":"Reduce the clients: roll back the pool-size change"},{"text":"Use the provided SQL query to list client backends and identify which roles hold slots","evidence_ids":["RB-012#5"],"quote":"SELECT usename, application_name, client_addr, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity"}],"next_checks":["Run the RB‑012 query to confirm current idle‑session count on orders‑db","Verify that the batch job now closes connections after each batch","Check orders‑api pool configuration and consider lowering max pool size if over‑provisioned","If needed, coordinate with team‑dba to raise max_connections after confirming memory capacity"]}
